edits.old: CASE WHEN rfm_segment IN ('Champions','Loyal Customers') THEN 'Reward loyalty and advocate' WHEN rfm_segment IN ('At Risk','Cannot Be Retrieved','Hibernating') THEN 'Re-engage customer' ELSE 'Standard engagement tactics' END recommended_strategy
edits.new: CASE rfm_segment WHEN 'Champions' THEN 'Reward them. They can become early adopters for new features and advocates.' WHEN 'Loyal Customers' THEN 'Upsell higher value products. Ask for reviews and referrals.' WHEN 'Potential Loyalists' THEN 'Offer membership/loyalty programs. Recommend complementary features.' WHEN 'New Customers' THEN 'Provide onboarding support. Start building relationships.' WHEN 'Promising' THEN 'Offer free trials of premium features. Engage them with content.' WHEN 'Customers Needing Attention' THEN 'Send personalized emails. Offer limited time offers.' WHEN 'About to Sleep' THEN 'Provide helpful resources. Send re-engagement campaigns.' WHEN 'At Risk' THEN 'Send win-back campaigns. Conduct exit interviews.' WHEN 'Cannot Be Retrieved' THEN 'Conduct customer research. Focus retention efforts elsewhere.' WHEN 'Hibernating' THEN 'Offer other relevant products. Send special offers to re-activate.' ELSE 'Standard engagement tactics.' END AS recommended_strategy

edits.old: CASE WHEN rfm_segment IN ('Champions','Loyal Customers') AND customer_lifetime_days>180 THEN 'Very High CLV' WHEN rfm_segment IN ('Champions','Loyal Customers') THEN 'High CLV' WHEN rfm_segment IN ('Potential Loyalists','Promising') THEN 'Medium CLV' ELSE 'Low CLV' END predicted_clv_tier
edits.new: CASE WHEN rfm_segment IN ('Champions', 'Loyal Customers') AND customer_lifetime_days > 180 THEN 'Very High CLV' WHEN rfm_segment IN ('Champions', 'Loyal Customers', 'Potential Loyalists') THEN 'High CLV' WHEN rfm_segment IN ('Promising', 'New Customers') THEN 'Medium CLV' WHEN rfm_segment IN ('Customers Needing Attention', 'About to Sleep', 'Hibernating') THEN 'Low CLV' ELSE 'Minimal CLV' END AS predicted_clv_tier

edits.old: CASE WHEN rfm_segment IN ('Champions','Loyal Customers') THEN 'Retention & Advocacy' WHEN rfm_segment IN ('Potential Loyalists','Promising') THEN 'Growth & Upsell' WHEN rfm_segment='New Customers' THEN 'Onboarding & Education' WHEN rfm_segment IN ('At Risk','Cannot Be Retrieved','Hibernating') THEN 'Re-engagement' ELSE 'Monitor' END action_priority
edits.new: CASE WHEN rfm_segment IN ('Champions', 'Loyal Customers') THEN 'Retention & Advocacy' WHEN rfm_segment IN ('Potential Loyalists', 'Promising') THEN 'Growth & Upsell' WHEN rfm_segment = 'New Customers' THEN 'Onboarding & Education' WHEN rfm_segment IN ('Customers Needing Attention', 'About to Sleep') THEN 'Re-engagement' WHEN rfm_segment IN ('At Risk', 'Cannot Be Retrieved') THEN 'Win-back or Deprioritize' WHEN rfm_segment = 'Hibernating' THEN 'Reactivation' ELSE 'Monitor' END AS action_priority
(SELECT count(*) FROM z az WHERE az.account_id=z.account_id) AS account_total_visitors
(SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE az.customer_value_tier='High Value')::FLOAT/count(*) FROM z az WHERE az.account_id=z.account_id) AS account_high_value_ratio
(SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE az.rfm_segment IN ('Champions','Loyal Customers'))::FLOAT/count(*) FROM z az WHERE az.account_id=z.account_id) AS account_top_segment_ratio
(SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE az.rfm_segment IN ('At Risk','Cannot Be Retrieved'))::FLOAT/count(*) FROM z az WHERE az.account_id=z.account_id) AS account_at_risk_ratio
(SELECT avg(az.rfm_composite_score) FROM z az WHERE az.account_id=z.account_id) AS account_avg_rfm_score
